about: Offline reliability run (tools/run-browser-lab.mjs): match A through the real UI entirely offline — installed online, then the preview server stopped and the browser taken offline before the match is created. These lifecycle steps are added to match A's fixture steps; they do not change any event, so match A's independent ledger applies unchanged. Each is judged: every stored event identical before and after, the clock resuming where it stopped. Protected by the test-integrity guard.
